title_zh: 印度尼西亚分散乙型肝炎病毒载量检测的开放系统实时定量 PCR 测定的开发和性能评估
source_body_en: Abstract Background Indonesia remains one of the countries with the highest burdens of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in Southeast Asia. Despite this substantial disease burden, a major gap in access to quantitative hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA testing potentially delays the diagnosis and treatment of CHB. This study aimed to develop and validate an open-system quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) assay, the INDIGEN HBV DNA qRT-PCR for detecting and quantifying HBV DNA viral load. Methods The assay was designed to target the S region of HBV and calibrated against the HBV World Health Organization (WHO) International Standard. Analytical performance was evaluated for linearity and limit of detection (LoD). A total of 122 HBsAg-positive samples from CHB patients were used to assess the clinical performance of our assay compared to the Xpert® HBV Viral Load (Xpert). Results The assay demonstrated excellent linearity across 1.0–9.0 log10 IU/mL (R2 = 0.9964) with a LoD of 14.8 IU/mL. Compared to Xpert, the developed assay showed 100% specificity and 99.05% sensitivity with strong correlation based on Deming regression analysis. Conclusions The INDIGEN HBV DNA qRT-PCR assay demonstrated robust evaluation performance comparable to the Xpert, supporting its implementation as a reliable open-system assay for decentralized HBV viral load testing in Indonesia.

title: Frequency of hepatitis B virus mutations associated with resistance to current and emerging drugs for functional cure in publicly available hepatitis B virus sequences
abstract: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains an immense global health challenge. Despite the availability of antiviral therapies, no curative treatment exists. Only a small proportion of individuals with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) achieve a functional cure. Resistance and vaccine escape mutations (EMs) may compromise current nucleos(t)ide analogs, vaccines and emerging therapies, leading to treatment failure. The present study aimed to assess the frequency of these HBV mutations in >17,000 publicly available patient-derived HBV sequences. Methods Fold-change (FC) data and resistance/escape-associated mutations were retrieved from literature searches. HBV sequences were retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide and NCBI Virus databases. Human HBV isolates were genotyped using the HBVdb and Stanford HBVseq tools and GenBank data. Genotype-specific alignments were generated using MAFFT v7 and mutations were analyzed across reverse transcriptase (RT), core (C), surface (S) and X regions using in-house Python scripts. Results From 19,192 sequence identifiers retrieved, 17,012 genotyped sequences were analyzed. Genotypes C, B, D and A comprised approximately 85% of the dataset. RT-mutations, L180M + M204V and M204I, were frequent in certain genotypes like A, G, H, AG, and G, respectively. C-mutations, Y38F, I105T, and T109M, were identified in common genotypes. In the S-protein, G145R, E164G, and E164D mutations were the most common and these mutations are known to alter the effectiveness of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). In general, S-mutations toward the studied mAbs occurred at low-to-moderate frequency. Some substitutions previously suggested to be vaccine escape-associated mutations were highly prevalent, however, these substitutions may be polymorphisms specific to certain genotypes requiring further validation. X-region mutations relevant for treatment based on antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) were uncommon overall. Conclusion HBV isolates with resistance and vaccine escape-associated mutations are present globally and might be genotype-dependent. Therefore, genotype and resistance assessment are crucial before initiating therapy for a favorable outcome in patients, especially when new drugs are introduced to achieve functional cure.

The research highlights that resistance and vaccine escape mutations are prevalent in certain genotypes, such as A, G, H, and others, and may impact the effectiveness of antiviral therapies and monoclonal antibodies. title_zh: 在公开的 乙型肝炎病毒 序列中,乙型肝炎病毒 突变 的频率与 功能性治愈 现有和新兴药物的耐药性相关
source_body_en: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains an immense global health challenge. Despite the availability of antiviral therapies, no curative treatment exists. Only a small proportion of individuals with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) achieve a functional cure. Resistance and vaccine escape mutations (EMs) may compromise current nucleos(t)ide analogs, vaccines and emerging therapies, leading to treatment failure. The present study aimed to assess the frequency of these HBV mutations in >17,000 publicly available patient-derived HBV sequences. Methods Fold-change (FC) data and resistance/escape-associated mutations were retrieved from literature searches. HBV sequences were retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide and NCBI Virus databases. Human HBV isolates were genotyped using the HBVdb and Stanford HBVseq tools and GenBank data. Genotype-specific alignments were generated using MAFFT v7 and mutations were analyzed across reverse transcriptase (RT), core (C), surface (S) and X regions using in-house Python scripts. Results From 19,192 sequence identifiers retrieved, 17,012 genotyped sequences were analyzed. Genotypes C, B, D and A comprised approximately 85% of the dataset. RT-mutations, L180M + M204V and M204I, were frequent in certain genotypes like A, G, H, AG, and G, respectively. C-mutations, Y38F, I105T, and T109M, were identified in common genotypes. In the S-protein, G145R, E164G, and E164D mutations were the most common and these mutations are known to alter the effectiveness of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). In general, S-mutations toward the studied mAbs occurred at low-to-moderate frequency. Some substitutions previously suggested to be vaccine escape-associated mutations were highly prevalent, however, these substitutions may be polymorphisms specific to certain genotypes requiring further validation. X-region mutations relevant for treatment based on antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) were uncommon overall. Conclusion HBV isolates with resistance and vaccine escape-associated mutations are present globally and might be genotype-dependent. Therefore, genotype and resistance assessment are crucial before initiating therapy for a favorable outcome in patients, especially when new drugs are introduced to achieve functional cure.
abstract_zh: 背景 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是一个巨大的全球健康挑战。尽管有 抗病毒药物 疗法,但尚不存在治愈性的 治疗。只有一小部分患有 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的个体达到了 功能性治愈。耐药性和 疫苗 逃逸 突变 (EM) 可能会损害当前的核苷(酸)类似物、疫苗 和新兴疗法,导致 治疗 失败。本研究旨在评估超过 17,000 个公开的患者来源的 HBV 序列中这些 HBV 突变 的频率。方法从文献检索中检索倍数变化(FC)数据和与抗性/逃逸相关的突变。HBV 序列取自 NCBI 核苷酸和 NCBI 病毒数据库。使用 HBVdb 和斯坦福大学 HBVseq 工具以及 GenBank 数据对人类 HBV 分离株进行基因分型。使用 MAFFT v7 生成基因型特异性比对,并使用内部 Python 脚本跨逆转录酶 (RT)、核心 (C)、表面 (S) 和 X 区域分析 突变。结果 从检索到的 19,192 个序列标识符中,分析了 17,012 个基因分型序列。基因型 C、B、D 和 A 约占数据集的 85%。RT-突变、L180M + M204V 和 M204I 分别在 A、G、H、AG 和 G 等某些基因型中常见。C-突变、Y38F、I105T 和 T109M 在常见基因型中被鉴定。在 S 蛋白中,G145R、E164G 和 E164D 突变 是最常见的,并且已知这些 突变 会改变单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的有效性。一般来说,针对所研究的单克隆抗体的 S-突变 发生频率为低至中等。先前认为与 疫苗 逃逸相关的 突变 的一些替换非常普遍,然而,这些替换可能是特定于某些基因型的多态性,需要进一步验证。总体而言,与基于反义寡核苷酸 (ASO) 的 治疗 相关的 X 区 突变 并不常见。结论 具有耐药性的 HBV 分离株和 疫苗 逃逸相关的 突变 在全球范围内存在,并且可能具有基因型依赖性。因此,在开始治疗以获得良好结果之前,基因型和耐药性评估至关重要,特别是在引入新药以实现 功能性治愈 时。

title: Hepatitis B splicing-generated protein prevents tumor initiation but shapes a pro-tumor immune microenvironment in established HCC.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plays a key role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) through both direct oncogenic and indirect immune-mediated mechanisms. Expression of the main HBV spliced transcript, sp1RNA, gradually increases in chronic carriers prior to HCC onset. However, sp1RNA and related Hepatitis B Splicing-generated Protein (HBSP) contributions to hepatic carcinogenesis and tumor microenvironment have not been investigated. METHODS: HBV-related HCC tumors from 57 patients were classified according to HBV expression (RT)-qPCR and profiled using Nanostring immuno-oncology panel. The functional impact of HBSP expression was evaluated in transgenic male mice (TgHBSP) subjected to diethylnitrosamine (DEN)-induced HCC. A second model using orthotopic allografts of HBSP-expressing cells was developed. Liver tissues and immune infiltrates were characterized at 48 h, 6- and 10-month post-DEN injection. RESULTS: In HBV-related HCC patients, sp1RNA expression was associated with worse overall survival and reduced monocyte/macrophage gene signature within tumors. In TgHBSP mice, tumor incidence was reduced at both 6- and 10-month post-DEN administration, associated with sustained p38-MAPK activation at the initiation stage of cancer. Despite lower tumor incidence, tumors arising in TgHBSP mice were twice as large at endpoint. Attenuated inflammatory signaling and macrophage polarization towards a pro-tumor phenotype were implicated in the pro-tumor effect of HBSP at early HCC. CONCLUSION: This study reveals a dual, stage-dependent, role for HBSP in liver carcinogenesis, exerting first anti-tumor effects associated with p38-MAPK activation at initiation stage of hepatic cancer, then pro-tumor effect on tumor growth and alterations in the immune microenvironment of established HCC.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the dual role of Hepatitis B Splicing-generated Protein (HBSP) in liver carcinogenesis. It reveals that HBSP initially exerts anti-tumor effects through p38-MAPK activation during the initiation stage of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but later contributes to tumor growth and shapes a pro-tumor immune microenvironment in established HCC. The research was conducted using patient samples and two animal models, including transgenic mice and orthotopic allografts. Results showed that sp1RNA expression was linked to worse overall survival and reduced monocyte/macrophage gene signatures in HCC patients. In mice, HBSP expression reduced tumor incidence but increased tumor size at endpoint. The study highlights the stage-dependent impact of HBSP on HCC progression and suggests potential implications for immune microenvironment targeting in treatment strategies. However, the evidence is moderate due to the limitations of observational and experimental models.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 通过直接致癌和间接免疫介导机制在肝细胞癌 (HCC) 中发挥关键作用。

title_zh: 乙型肝炎剪接生成的蛋白质可防止肿瘤发生,但在已形成的肝癌中形成促肿瘤免疫微环境。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plays a key role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) through both direct oncogenic and indirect immune-mediated mechanisms. Expression of the main HBV spliced transcript, sp1RNA, gradually increases in chronic carriers prior to HCC onset. However, sp1RNA and related Hepatitis B Splicing-generated Protein (HBSP) contributions to hepatic carcinogenesis and tumor microenvironment have not been investigated. METHODS: HBV-related HCC tumors from 57 patients were classified according to HBV expression (RT)-qPCR and profiled using Nanostring immuno-oncology panel. The functional impact of HBSP expression was evaluated in transgenic male mice (TgHBSP) subjected to diethylnitrosamine (DEN)-induced HCC. A second model using orthotopic allografts of HBSP-expressing cells was developed. Liver tissues and immune infiltrates were characterized at 48 h, 6- and 10-month post-DEN injection. RESULTS: In HBV-related HCC patients, sp1RNA expression was associated with worse overall survival and reduced monocyte/macrophage gene signature within tumors. In TgHBSP mice, tumor incidence was reduced at both 6- and 10-month post-DEN administration, associated with sustained p38-MAPK activation at the initiation stage of cancer. Despite lower tumor incidence, tumors arising in TgHBSP mice were twice as large at endpoint. Attenuated inflammatory signaling and macrophage polarization towards a pro-tumor phenotype were implicated in the pro-tumor effect of HBSP at early HCC. CONCLUSION: This study reveals a dual, stage-dependent, role for HBSP in liver carcinogenesis, exerting first anti-tumor effects associated with p38-MAPK activation at initiation stage of hepatic cancer, then pro-tumor effect on tumor growth and alterations in the immune microenvironment of established HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景和目的:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 通过直接致癌和间接免疫介导机制在肝细胞癌 (HCC) 中发挥关键作用。在 HCC 发病前,慢性携带者中主要 HBV 剪接转录物 sp1RNA 的表达逐渐增加。然而,sp1RNA 和相关乙型肝炎剪接生成蛋白 (HBSP) 对肝癌发生和肿瘤微环境的贡献尚未得到研究。方法:根据 HBV 表达 (RT)-qPCR 对 57 名患者的 HBV 相关 HCC 肿瘤进行分类,并使用 Nanostring 免疫肿瘤学面板进行分析。在遭受二乙基亚硝胺 (DEN) 诱导的 HCC 的转基因雄性小鼠 (TgHBSP) 中评估了 HBSP 表达的功能影响。开发了使用 HBSP 表达细胞的原位同种异体移植的第二种模型。DEN 注射后 48 小时、6 个月和 10 个月对肝组织和免疫浸润进行了表征。结果:在 HBV 相关 HCC 患者中,sp1RNA 表达与较差的总体生存率和肿瘤内单核细胞/巨噬细胞基因特征减少相关。在 TgHBSP 小鼠中,DEN 给药后 6 个月和 10 个月时,肿瘤 发病率 均减少,这与癌症起始阶段 p38-MAPK 的持续激活有关。尽管 发病率 肿瘤较小,但 TgHBSP 小鼠中产生的肿瘤在终点时是两倍大。炎症信号减弱和巨噬细胞向促肿瘤表型极化与 HBSP 在早期 HCC 中的促肿瘤作用有关。结论:本研究揭示了 HBSP 在肝癌发生中的双重、阶段依赖性作用,首先在肝癌起始阶段发挥与 p38-MAPK 激活相关的抗肿瘤作用,然后对肿瘤生长和已建立的 HCC 免疫微环境的改变产生促肿瘤作用。

title: Trajectories of serum hepatitis B surface antigen predict HBeAg clearance in treated children with chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Background The association between the early dynamics of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and its subsequent clearance has been observed in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its relationship with other clinical outcomes remains poorly understood. Objective This study aimed to investigate the longitudinal trajectories patterns of HBsAg and their associations with hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) clearance in pediatric patients with CHB undergoing antiviral treatment. Methods A large retrospective cohort study was conducted on 402 pediatric patients with HBeAg-positive CHB. Latent class trajectory models (LCTM) were applied to examine HBsAg trajectories within the first six months of initiating antiviral therapy. Cox proportional hazard models were used to assess the associations between HBsAg trajectories and HBeAg clearance. Results Among the 402 participants, the median age was 5 years, with 249 (61.94%) being male. During a median follow-up of 19.03 months, 216 participants (53.73%) achieved HBeAg clearance. LCTM revealed three distinct HBsAg trajectory patterns: ‘trajectory 1’ (sustained stability, n=43, 10.7%), ‘trajectory 2’ (slow decline, n=195, 48.5%), and ‘trajectory 3’ (rapid decline, n=164, 40.8%). Patients in trajectories 2 and 3 had significantly higher probabilities of HBeAg clearance compared to those in trajectory 1 (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] = 3.99, 95% CI, 2.20-7.22 for trajectory 2; aHR = 7.21, 95% CI, 3.65-14.24 for trajectory 3). Conclusions There is significant heterogeneity in the longitudinal changes of HBsAg levels among pediatric CHB patients with antiviral treatment. Approximately half of the patients exhibited a substantial HBsAg decline, which was associated with a higher likelihood of HBeAg clearance.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the longitudinal trajectories of HBsAg in pediatric patients with chronic hepatitis B undergoing antiviral treatment and their association with HBeAg clearance. title: Birth in the Neonatal Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) Vaccination Era and Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Seroclearance in People With HIV-1 and HBV Coinfection on Tenofovir-containing Antiretroviral Therapy.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The impact of long-term tenofovir-containing antiretroviral therapy (ART) on hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance in people with HIV-1 (PWH) and HBV coinfection remains under-defined, particularly in HBV-hyperendemic regions with universal neonatal vaccination programs. METHODS: HBsAg-positive PWH receiving tenofovir-containing ART between 2011 and 2023 were followed until December 2025. Demographics, HBV serologic markers, plasma HBV DNA, and liver fibrosis stage were collected. Cox proportional hazards models were used to identify factors associated with HBsAg seroclearance. Clinical and hepatic outcomes were compared with seroclearance status. RESULTS: After a median follow-up of 9.4 years, 35 (8.4%) of 415 PWH achieved HBsAg seroclearance during a total of 3600 person-years of tenofovir-containing ART, corresponding to an incidence rate of 0.97 per 100 person-years. Among them, 37.1% (13/35) tested positive for anti-HBs at the time of seroclearance. In multivariable analysis, birth in universal neonatal HBV vaccination era (after July 1986) (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 13.56, 95% confidence interval [CI] 6.08-30.28, P < .001), baseline HBsAg ≤250 IU/mL (aHR 7.36, 95% CI 3.29-16.50, P < .001), and higher baseline ALT level (aHR 1.00 per 1-U/L increase, 95% CI 1.00-1.01, P < .001) were independently associated with HBsAg seroclearance. None of PWH who achieved HBsAg seroclearance developed seroreversion, cirrhosis, or hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), whereas 6.6% and 2.1% of PWH without seroclearance developed cirrhosis and HCC, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Despite long-term tenofovir-containing ART, HBsAg seroclearance was uncommon (0.97% annually) among PWH with HBV coinfection. Birth in the neonatal HBV vaccination era and lower baseline HBsAg level were 2 independent predictors of HBsAg seroclearance.
journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

title: Translational Multiplexed Raman Pathological Imaging for Precise Diagnosis of HBV-Associated Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
abstract: Multiplexed vibrational imaging holds great potential for tissue molecular analysis, yet fully standardized workflows suitable for routine clinical histopathology remain scarce. Herein, we report a clinically applicable methodology using monodisperse triple-bond Raman polymer nanoparticles (∼50 nm). This approach integrates one-step labeling and single-scan acquisition to achieve high-performance multiplexed Raman imaging of 5 protein markers in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) tissues. Targeting hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated HCC, our biomarker panel combines the viral protein HBx with 4 clinically used indicators: AFP, GS, GPC3, and CD34. We further reveal a clinically critical dissociation: several high-grade HBV-HCC specimens exhibit markedly elevated oncogenic markers with comparatively low HBx expression, consistent with antiviral therapy suppressing viral protein production without reversing tumor aggressiveness. Taking advantage of the ultranarrow, well-resolved signals generated by triple-bond tags within the biological silent region (1800-2800 cm-1), we achieve high-fidelity spatial mapping and quantitative analysis. Unlike conventional pathological methods relying on morphological observation, clinical manifestations, or single-marker detection, this technique simultaneously evaluates viral etiology, tumor progression, and metastatic potential, effectively reducing misclassification risk in patients with discordant viral and oncogenic profiles, and completes the entire assay within approximately 24 h. This study establishes a rapid and reliable histopathological platform that integrates pathogen identification and comprehensive cancer characterization, demonstrating substantial value for both cancer research and clinical diagnostics.

title_zh: 转化多重拉曼病理成像用于 HBV 相关肝细胞癌的精确 诊断。

abstract_zh: 多重振动成像在组织分子分析方面具有巨大潜力,但适合常规临床组织病理学的完全标准化工作流程仍然很少。在此,我们报告了一种使用单分散三键拉曼聚合物纳米颗粒(∼50 nm)的临床适用方法。该方法集成了一步标记和单次扫描采集,可实现肝细胞癌 (HCC) 组织中 5 种蛋白质标记物的高性能多重拉曼成像。针对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关 HCC,我们的生物标志物组合将病毒蛋白 HBx 与 4 个临床使用的指标相结合:AFP、GS、GPC3 和 CD34。我们进一步揭示了临床上关键的分离:几个高级别 HBV-HCC 标本表现出显着升高的致癌标志物,而 HBx 表达相对较低,这与 抗病毒药物 疗法抑制病毒蛋白产生而不逆转肿瘤侵袭性一致。利用生物沉默区域(1800-2800 cm-1)内三键标签产生的超窄、高分辨率信号,我们实现了高保真空间映射和定量分析。与依赖形态学观察、临床表现或单标志物检测的传统病理方法不同,该技术同时评估病毒病原学、肿瘤进展和转移潜力,有效降低病毒和致癌谱不一致患者的错误分类风险,并在约24小时内完成整个检测。这项研究建立了一个快速、可靠的组织病理学平台,整合了病原体识别和全面的癌症表征,展示了对癌症研究和临床诊断的巨大价值。

title: Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation and Antiviral Prophylaxis Practices in Patients with Malignancies Receiving Chemotherapy: A Real-World Retrospective Study
abstract: Background and Objectives: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation is a potentially life-threatening complication in patients receiving chemotherapy and immunosuppressive therapy. Real-world data regarding reactivation despite antiviral prophylaxis remain limited. Materials and Methods: We retrospectively evaluated patients with malignancies who received chemotherapy at Kocaeli University Faculty of Medicine Hospital between 2013 and 2017. Demographic characteristics, malignancy type, virological markers, laboratory findings, chemotherapy regimens, antiviral prophylaxis strategies, and HBV reactivation rates were analyzed. Results: A total of 294 patients were included in this study, of whom 18 (6.1%) experienced HBV reactivation. Reactivation was significantly more common in patients with hematologic malignancies (11.1%) than in patients with solid tumors (3.2%). Bone marrow transplantation was associated with a higher observed frequency of HBV reactivation. HBV reactivation was observed in a subset of patients receiving antiviral prophylaxis. Delayed initiation of antiviral treatment and irregular antiviral use were documented in some patients who developed HBV reactivation. Conclusions: Malignancies and intensive immunosuppressive therapies were associated with an increased risk of HBV reactivation despite prophylactic strategies. The results of our study also highlight the importance of HBV screening before chemotherapy, timely initiation of potent antiviral prophylaxis, and extended post-treatment monitoring in high-risk populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是接受化疗和免疫抑制治疗的患者潜在的危及生命的并发症。该研究旨在评估接受化疗的恶性肿瘤患者的 患病率 和 HBV 再激活的危险因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究评估了 2013 年至 2017 年间在科贾埃利大学医学院医院接受化疗的恶性肿瘤患者。该研究总共包括 294 名患者,重点关注那些经历过 HBV 再激活的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究回顾性分析了人口特征、恶性肿瘤类型、病毒学标志物、实验室检查结果、化疗方案、抗病毒药物 预防策略和 HBV 再激活率。从医疗记录中收集数据并审查相关临床和病毒学参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 这项研究总共纳入了 294 名患者,其中 18 名(6.1%)经历了 HBV 再激活。血液系统恶性肿瘤患者(11.1%)的再激活明显高于实体瘤患者(3.2%)。骨髓移植与观察到的乙型肝炎病毒再激活频率较高相关。在接受 抗病毒药物 预防的患者亚组中观察到 HBV 再激活。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,尽管采取了预防策略,但恶性肿瘤和强化免疫抑制治疗仍与 HBV 再激活风险增加相关。这项研究强调了在高危人群中进行针对性 抗病毒药物 预防的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了化疗前 HBV 筛查、及时启动有效的 抗病毒药物 预防以及在高危人群中延长 治疗 后监测的重要性。这些见解可以为临床实践提供参考,以降低恶性肿瘤患者乙型肝炎病毒再激活的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的数据缺失而受到限制。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它基于来自明确人群的真实数据,并包括特定的比率和风险因素。

abstract_zh: 背景和目的:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是接受化疗和免疫抑制治疗的患者潜在的危及生命的并发症。尽管进行 抗病毒药物 预防,有关重新激活的真实数据仍然有限。材料和方法:我们回顾性评估了 2013 年至 2017 年在科贾埃利大学医学院医院接受化疗的恶性肿瘤患者。分析了人口学特征、恶性肿瘤类型、病毒学标志物、实验室检查结果、化疗方案、抗病毒药物 预防策略和 HBV 再激活率。结果:本研究共纳入 294 名患者,其中 18 名(6.1%)经历了 HBV 再激活。血液系统恶性肿瘤患者(11.1%)的再激活明显高于实体瘤患者(3.2%)。骨髓移植与观察到的乙型肝炎病毒再激活频率较高相关。在接受 抗病毒药物 预防的患者亚组中观察到 HBV 再激活。在一些发生 HBV 再激活的患者中记录了 抗病毒药物 的延迟启动和 抗病毒药物 的不规则使用。结论:尽管采取了预防策略,但恶性肿瘤和强化免疫抑制治疗仍与 HBV 再激活风险增加相关。我们的研究结果还强调了化疗前 HBV 筛查、及时启动有效的 抗病毒药物 预防以及在高危人群中延长 治疗 后监测的重要性。

title: Catastrophic Health Expenditure among Patients Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection: Evidence from Federal University Teaching Hospital, Lafia, Nigeria
abstract: This study examines catastrophic health expenditure (CHE) among patients managing chronic Hepatitis B virus (CHBV) infection in Federal University Teaching Hospital, Lafia, Nasarawa State, Nigeria.The study covers a 12-month recall period ending in 2026, drawing on hospital-based cross-sectional survey data from 108 adult CHBV patients attending the Gastroenterology Unit of the teaching hospital.The study adopts a prevalence-based Cost-of-Illness framework, benchmarking total annual patient expenditure against household income using the World Health Organization's catastrophic health expenditure thresholds (outof-pocket payments exceeding 10 percent of household income or 40 percent of capacity to pay), and tests bivariate associations between income, insurance enrolment, and treatment interruption using chi-square analysis.The findings show that CHBV management imposes an average annual economic burden of ₦738,049.26per patient, an amount that exceeds the WHO catastrophic threshold at every observed household income level, from below 30.75 percent of annual income among the highest earners to several times annual income among the lowest earners.Consistent with this, 83 percent of patients reported financial stress and 41 percent had delayed or discontinued treatment for financial reasons, with household income significantly associated with treatment interruption.while health insurance enrolment was low, reflecting the shallow depth of coverage even among the insured.Based on the findings, the study recommends that government and health insurance providers expand comprehensive, adequately resourced coverage for HBV diagnostics and antiviral medication, decentralise chronic HBV care to primary and secondary facilities, and prioritise catastrophic-expenditure monitoring as a routine indicator of financial risk protection in Nigeria's path toward universal health coverage.
journal: Lafia Journal of Economics and Management Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study investigates the economic burden of chronic Hepatitis B virus (CHBV) infection and its impact on catastrophic health expenditure (CHE) among patients in Nigeria. The research addresses the growing concern of financial strain associated with managing CHBV, particularly in low-income settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a hospital-based cross-sectional survey conducted at Federal University Teaching Hospital, Lafia, Nasarawa State, Nigeria, over a 12-month recall period ending in 2026. It includes 108 adult patients with chronic HBV infection attending the Gastroenterology Unit.
analysis.methods: The study uses a prevalence-based Cost-of-Illness framework to assess the economic burden by comparing total annual patient expenditure with household income. It applies the World Health Organization's catastrophic health expenditure thresholds and uses chi-square analysis to test associations between income, insurance enrolment, and treatment interruption.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the average annual economic burden of CHBV management is ₦738,049.26 per patient, exceeding the WHO catastrophic threshold at all observed income levels. Additionally, 83 percent of patients reported financial stress, and 41 percent delayed or discontinued treatment due to financial reasons.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the high economic burden of CHBV management contributes to significant financial stress and treatment interruptions, highlighting the need for improved financial protection mechanisms. This study provides novel insights into the financial implications of CHBV in a Nigerian context.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of expanding health insurance coverage and improving access to antiviral medications for CHBV patients in Nigeria. They also emphasize the need for routine monitoring of catastrophic health expenditure as part of broader efforts toward universal health coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single hospital setting and relies on self-reported data, which may introduce bias. Despite these limitations, the evidence is moderate in strength due to the use of established WHO thresholds and statistical analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the economic burden of chronic Hepatitis B virus (CHBV) infection in Nigeria, focusing on catastrophic health expenditure (CHE) among 108 adult patients. Using a cross-sectional survey and the WHO's CHE thresholds, the research finds that CHBV management imposes an average annual cost of ₦738,049.26 per patient, exceeding the threshold at all income levels. Financial stress and treatment interruptions are prevalent, with 83% of patients reporting financial strain and 41% discontinuing treatment due to cost. The study highlights the need for expanded health insurance coverage and improved financial protection mechanisms for CHBV patients. While the findings are based on a single hospital setting and self-reported data, they provide valuable insights into the financial implications of CHBV in Nigeria, supporting the push for universal health coverage.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究调查了尼日利亚患者 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (CHBV) 感染的经济负担及其对灾难性医疗支出 (CHE) 的影响。该研究解决了人们日益关注的与管理 CHBV 相关的财务压力,特别是在低收入环境中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项以医院为基础的横断面调查,在尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州拉菲亚联邦大学教学医院进行,回顾期为 12 个月,截至 2026 年。研究对象包括 108 名在胃肠病科就诊的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用基于 患病率 的疾病成本框架,通过比较年度患者总支出与家庭收入来评估经济负担。它应用世界卫生组织的灾难性医疗支出阈值,并使用卡方分析来测试收入、保险参保和 治疗 中断之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: The study found that the average annual economic burden of CHBV management is ₦738,049.26 per patient, exceeding the WHO catastrophic threshold at all observed income levels. Additionally, 83 percent of patients reported financial stress, and 41 percent delayed or discontinued treatment due to financial reasons.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,CHBV 管理的高经济负担导致了巨大的财务压力和 治疗 中断,凸显了改进财务保护机制的必要性。这项研究为尼日利亚 CHBV 的财务影响提供了新颖的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了扩大尼日利亚 CHBV 患者健康保险覆盖范围和改善获得 抗病毒药物 药物的重要性。他们还强调需要对灾难性卫生支出进行常规监测,作为实现全民健康覆盖的更广泛努力的一部分。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单一医院环境,并依赖于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。尽管存在这些限制,但由于使用了世卫组织既定阈值和统计分析,证据强度中等。

title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

title: Multicomponent Interventions to Improve Hepatitis B Vaccination Uptake Among Double-Negative Population
abstract: A substantial proportion of individuals identified through hepatitis B screening are double-negative (HBsAg-negative and anti-HBs-negative) and remain fully susceptible to hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection despite the availability of an effective vaccine. PubMed, Web of Science, and CNKI were searched for literature published between January 2000 and December 2025 on barriers to HBV vaccination in double-negative populations and the interventions addressing them. Barriers operate at individual (knowledge deficits, vaccine hesitancy), service delivery (geographic inaccessibility, financial burden, disconnected screening-to-vaccination pathways), and policy (weak provider incentives, insufficient cross-sector coordination) levels. Reported interventions comprise patient-oriented strategies (reminder and recall, Health Belief Model- and Theory of Planned Behavior-based education, community engagement), provider-oriented approaches (clinical decision support, vaccination incentives, Plan-Do-Study-Act cycles), and policy-level measures (controlled temperature chain, pay-it-forward, service decentralization). Multicomponent bundles may be complementary and produce greater effects than single components; however, direct head-to-head evidence in the double-negative population is limited. Double-negative status is a convergent end-point phenotype of three immunological trajectories (never-vaccinated, vaccine non-responders, and waned immunity), and interventions should therefore be stratified accordingly. A “Screening-Education-Vaccination-Follow-up” framework is proposed, and pragmatic cluster-randomized trials with nested cost-effectiveness analyses should be prioritized.

title: Synthetic Biology in the Design and Development of Virus-Like Particle Vaccines
abstract: With the frequent emergence of new infectious diseases and the growing demand for precision medicine, the limitations of traditional vaccines are becoming increasingly apparent. Virus-like particles (VLPs) have become a key platform for the development of next-generation vaccines due to their combination of structural characteristics typical of natural viruses and a favorable safety profile. From the perspective of synthetic biology, this article reviews the working principles, production processes, and key construction technologies of VLP vaccines, with a focus on research progress regarding chassis protein design, engineering modification of antigen modules, optimization of linkage systems, and enhancement of structural stability. Meanwhile, the development status of marketed VLP vaccines, such as those for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis E virus (HEV), and human papillomavirus (HPV) is summarized, and the application of VLP vaccines currently in clinical research, including those for influenza, COVID-19, and HIV is analyzed. The results demonstrate that synthetic biology has significantly enhanced the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines, driving their evolution toward multivalent, intelligent, and personalized forms. However, issues such as complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy remain to be addressed. Future research could further integrate AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to advance the clinical translation and industrial application of VLP vaccines.
journal: International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences

Virus-like particles (VLPs) have become a key platform for the development of next-generation vaccines due to their combination of structural characteristics typical of natural viruses and a favorable safety profile. From the perspective of synthetic biology, this article reviews the working principles, production processes, and key construction technologies of VLP vaccines, with a focus on research progress regarding chassis protein design, engineering modification of antigen modules, optimization of linkage systems, and enhancement of structural stability. Meanwhile, the development status of marketed VLP vaccines, such as those for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis E virus (HEV), and human papillomavirus (HPV) is summarized, and the application of VLP vaccines currently in clinical research, including those for influenza, COVID-19, and HIV is analyzed. The results demonstrate that synthetic biology has significantly enhanced the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines, driving their evolution toward multivalent, intelligent, and personalized forms. However, issues such as complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy remain to be addressed. Future research could further integrate AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to advance the clinical translation and industrial application of VLP vaccines.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the design and development of virus-like particle (VLP) vaccines using synthetic biology, with an emphasis on hepatitis B virus (HBV) as the target. The central question is how synthetic biology can enhance the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines for HBV.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the working principles, production processes, and key construction technologies of VLP vaccines, with a focus on HBV. It summarizes the development status of marketed VLP vaccines for HBV and analyzes their application in clinical research, including those for influenza, COVID-19, and HIV.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that synthetic biology has significantly enhanced the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines, driving their evolution toward multivalent, intelligent, and personalized forms. It highlights progress in chassis protein design, engineering modification of antigen modules, optimization of linkage systems, and enhancement of structural stability.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies unresolved issues such as complex antigen display, large-scale production challenges, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy as critical evidence gaps that require further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should integrate AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to advance the clinical translation and industrial application of VLP vaccines, particularly for HBV.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of synthetic biology in the design and development of virus-like particle (VLP) vaccines, with a focus on hepatitis B virus (HBV). It outlines the working principles, production processes, and key technologies used in VLP vaccine development, emphasizing progress in chassis protein design, antigen module engineering, linkage system optimization, and structural stability enhancement. The review summarizes the development status of marketed HBV VLP vaccines and analyzes their application in clinical research. It highlights the significant improvements in VLP vaccine programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency achieved through synthetic biology. However, it also identifies unresolved challenges, including complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy. The review suggests future research directions that involve integrating AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to further advance the clinical and industrial applications of VLP vaccines for HBV.

abstract_zh: 随着新发传染病的频繁出现和精准医疗需求的不断增长,传统疫苗的局限性日益显现。病毒样颗粒(VLP)由于结合了天然病毒的典型结构特征和良好的安全性,已成为开发下一代 疫苗 的关键平台。本文从合成生物学的角度,综述了VLP 疫苗的工作原理、生产工艺和关键构建技术,重点介绍了底盘蛋白设计、抗原模块工程化改造、连锁系统优化、结构稳定性增强等方面的研究进展。同时,对已上市的病毒颗粒疫苗(HBV)、戊型肝炎病毒(HEV)、人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)等的开发现状进行了总结,并分析了病毒颗粒疫苗目前在流感、COVID-19、HIV等临床研究中的应用情况。结果表明,合成生物学显着增强了VLP 疫苗的可编程性、免疫原性和开发效率,推动其进化走向多价、智能和个性化形式。然而,复杂抗原展示、大规模生产以及长期保护功效评估等问题仍有待解决。未来的研究可以进一步整合人工智能驱动的蛋白质设计、新型表达系统和精准递送技术,以推进VLP 疫苗的临床转化和工业应用。

title: Seroprevalence of Hepatitis B and C Viruses and Association with Biochemical Parameters among Patients Tested for Viral Hepatitis in Cumilla, Bangladesh: A Cross-sectional Study
abstract: Background: Viral hepatitis, caused mainly by hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV), is a leading cause of liver-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, contributing to an estimated 1.3 million deaths annually. Bangladesh is considered intermediate-endemic for HBV, yet data on the proportion of viral hepatitis and associated biochemical alterations among patients in downtown Cumilla remain scarce. Objective: To determine the proportion of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections among patients tested for viral hepatitis in downtown Cumilla, Bangladesh, and to examine their association with age, sex, and biochemical parameters (SGPT/ALT and serum bilirubin). Methods: A cross-sectional, laboratory-based study was conducted among 100 patients who attended selected diagnostic centres and healthcare facilities in downtown Cumilla for viral hepatitis testing between January and August 2026, who were recruited consecutively using convenience sampling. Age, sex, HBsAg, Anti-HCV, serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase (SGPT/ALT) and serum bilirubin were obtained from laboratory reports and patient records. Associations were analysed using chi-square tests (with continuity correction for 2×2 tables) and independent-samples t-tests, with p

title: Adoptive Immune Transfer in the Functional Cure of Chronic Hepatitis B: Insights from Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains challenging, primarily due to the inability to reconstitute effective host immune responses against the virus. The unexpected functional cure of chronic hepatitis B following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation provides a unique proof-of-principle model for immune-mediated HBsAg clearance. This review aims to elucidate that the core mechanism underlying hematopoietic stem cell transplantation-mediated HBsAg clearance lies in “adoptive immune transfer”, and to explore design principles and future directions for modern cell-based immunotherapies based on this mechanism. We reviewed available case reports and meta-analytic evidence, acknowledging their limitations, and dissected the immunological mechanisms by which donor-derived hepatitis B virus-specific T and B cells may jointly reconstitute adaptive immunity and break host immune tolerance. We then comparatively evaluated the technical characteristics and limitations of chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy and T-cell receptor-engineered T-cell therapy. Current engineered T-cell therapies, while translating the core principle of adoptive transfer, exhibit fundamental limitations including monoclonal specificity, inability to remodel the host microenvironment, and absence of durable humoral reconstitution. A broader functional-cure strategy may require adopting the paradigm of synergy and systemic immune reshaping exemplified by hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Future strategies should develop temporally optimized, multilayered combination therapies, offering a possible pathway for next-generation therapeutics capable of systemically rebuilding antiviral immunity.
journal: Journal of Clinical and Translational Hepatology

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎的功能性治愈中的过继免疫转移:来自造血干细胞移植的见解
source_body_en: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains challenging, primarily due to the inability to reconstitute effective host immune responses against the virus. The unexpected functional cure of chronic hepatitis B following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation provides a unique proof-of-principle model for immune-mediated HBsAg clearance. This review aims to elucidate that the core mechanism underlying hematopoietic stem cell transplantation-mediated HBsAg clearance lies in “adoptive immune transfer”, and to explore design principles and future directions for modern cell-based immunotherapies based on this mechanism. We reviewed available case reports and meta-analytic evidence, acknowledging their limitations, and dissected the immunological mechanisms by which donor-derived hepatitis B virus-specific T and B cells may jointly reconstitute adaptive immunity and break host immune tolerance. We then comparatively evaluated the technical characteristics and limitations of chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy and T-cell receptor-engineered T-cell therapy. Current engineered T-cell therapies, while translating the core principle of adoptive transfer, exhibit fundamental limitations including monoclonal specificity, inability to remodel the host microenvironment, and absence of durable humoral reconstitution. A broader functional-cure strategy may require adopting the paradigm of synergy and systemic immune reshaping exemplified by hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Future strategies should develop temporally optimized, multilayered combination therapies, offering a possible pathway for next-generation therapeutics capable of systemically rebuilding antiviral immunity.

title: Hepatitis C seroprevalence and its association with injecting drug use among people who use drugs in the West Bank, Palestine: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: People who use drugs (PWUD) are at increased risk of blood-borne viral infections. Evidence on hepatitis C virus (HCV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) among PWUD in Palestine is limited. This study determined the seroprevalence of HCV, HBV, and HIV among PWUD attending governmental substance use disorder (SUD) treatment centers in the West Bank. METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 397 PWUD in SUD treatment centers in the West Bank during 2019-2023. Serological results for anti-HCV, HBsAg, and anti-HIV were obtained from routine clinical records. Crude and adjusted prevalence ratios (PRs) for the association between injecting drug use and anti-HCV seropositivity were estimated using modified Poisson regression. RESULTS: HCV seroprevalence was 23.0%, HBsAg prevalence was 2.0%, and no HIV was detected. HCV seroprevalence was 55.4% among injecting versus 6.7% among non-injecting users. After adjustment for age, education, employment status, and previous treatment attempts, injecting drug use remained strongly associated with HCV seropositivity (adjusted PR = 6.43, 95% CI 3.82-10.82). HCV prevalence increased with longer duration of drug use (p for trend <0.001), and varied significantly across governorates. CONCLUSIONS: HCV is the predominant infection among PWUD receiving SUD treatment in the West Bank, whereas HBV prevalence was low and HIV was not detected. Injecting drug use was strongly associated with HCV seropositivity, and prevalence increased with longer duration of drug use. Integrating HCV screening, RNA testing, antiviral treatment, and harm-reduction policies into SUD services is essential to achieve the WHO 2030 hepatitis elimination targets.

title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

title_zh: 聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2b 添加到核苷(酸)类似物可减少肝细胞癌和晚期纤维化的失代偿 慢性乙型肝炎
source_body_en: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

title: Knowledge, Attitude and Practices regarding Hepatitis B Infection and Vaccination among Healthcare Workers in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B, although a vaccine preventable disease, is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. The prevalence is four folds higher among healthcare workers (HCW). Therefore, the objective of this study was to assess and compare the KAP towards Hepatitis B vaccination among different groups of healthcare workers in a tertiary hospital. Methods: Cross-sectional survey was conducted with a questionnaire to gather information from different groups of healthcare workers which included doctors, nurses, dentists and lab technicians in a tertiary hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka. The data collected was coded and analyzed using SPSS software version 23. ANOVA was then used for finding the mean difference between the groups. Results: This cross-sectional study included N = 121 healthcare professionals (doctors n = 31, dental surgeons n = 30, nurses n = 30, lab technicians n = 30). Demographic variables were also stratified by professional groups to minimize confounding. Chi-square test showed no significant difference in gender or age distribution across groups (p > 0.05). Moreover, one-way ANOVA demonstrated statistically significant differences in knowledge, attitude, practice, and total KAP scores across professional groups (p 0.05). In addition, effect size analysis showed moderate-to-large effects, with professional category explaining 16% variance in knowledge, 21% in attitude, 9% in practice, and 24% in total KAP scores. Conclusion: The study showed KAP gap in HCW’s regarding hepatitis B, and more so in paramedical workers. This gap needs to be filled with the creation of a central database, regular reminders for vaccination, strengthening of the HICC, and waste disposal guidance to HCWs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎虽然是 疫苗 可预防的疾病,但却是全球 疫苗 的主要原因之一。医护人员 (HCW) 的 患病率 比例高出四倍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过问卷进行横断面调查,收集来自卡纳塔克邦班加罗尔一家三级医院的不同医护人员群体的信息,其中包括医生、护士、牙医和实验室技术人员。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 SPSS 软件版本 23 对收集的数据进行编码和分析。然后使用方差分析来查找组之间的平均差异。
elements_zh.main_results: 这项横断面研究包括 N = 121 名医疗保健专业人员(医生 n = 31、牙科医生 n = 30、护士 n = 30、实验室技术人员 n = 30)。卡方检验显示各组的性别或年龄分布没有显着差异(p > 0.05)。此外,单因素方差分析显示不同专业群体在知识、态度、实践和总 KAP 分数方面存在统计显着差异 (p < 0.05)。此外,效应量分析显示出中等至较大的影响,其中专业类别解释了知识差异的 16%、态度差异的 21%、实践差异的 9% 和总 KAP 分数的差异 24%。

title_zh: 卡纳塔克邦班加罗尔三级护理医院医护人员关于乙型肝炎感染和 疫苗接种 的知识、态度和实践
source_body_en: Background: Hepatitis B, although a vaccine preventable disease, is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. The prevalence is four folds higher among healthcare workers (HCW). Therefore, the objective of this study was to assess and compare the KAP towards Hepatitis B vaccination among different groups of healthcare workers in a tertiary hospital. Methods: Cross-sectional survey was conducted with a questionnaire to gather information from different groups of healthcare workers which included doctors, nurses, dentists and lab technicians in a tertiary hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka. The data collected was coded and analyzed using SPSS software version 23. ANOVA was then used for finding the mean difference between the groups. Results: This cross-sectional study included N = 121 healthcare professionals (doctors n = 31, dental surgeons n = 30, nurses n = 30, lab technicians n = 30). Demographic variables were also stratified by professional groups to minimize confounding. Chi-square test showed no significant difference in gender or age distribution across groups (p > 0.05). Moreover, one-way ANOVA demonstrated statistically significant differences in knowledge, attitude, practice, and total KAP scores across professional groups (p 0.05). In addition, effect size analysis showed moderate-to-large effects, with professional category explaining 16% variance in knowledge, 21% in attitude, 9% in practice, and 24% in total KAP scores. Conclusion: The study showed KAP gap in HCW’s regarding hepatitis B, and more so in paramedical workers. This gap needs to be filled with the creation of a central database, regular reminders for vaccination, strengthening of the HICC, and waste disposal guidance to HCWs.
abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎虽然是 疫苗 可预防的疾病,但却是全球 疫苗 的主要原因之一。医护人员 (HCW) 的 患病率 比例高出四倍。因此,本研究的目的是评估和比较三级医院不同群体的医护人员对乙型肝炎疫苗接种的KAP。方法:通过问卷进行横断面调查,收集卡纳塔克邦班加罗尔一家三级医院不同群体医护人员的信息,包括医生、护士、牙医和实验室技术人员。使用 SPSS 软件版本 23 对收集的数据进行编码和分析。然后使用方差分析来查找组之间的平均差异。结果:这项横断面研究包括 N = 121 名医疗保健专业人员(医生 n = 31、牙科医生 n = 30、护士 n = 30、实验室技术人员 n = 30)。人口统计变量也按专业群体进行分层,以尽量减少混淆。卡方检验显示各组的性别或年龄分布没有显着差异(p > 0.05)。此外,单因素方差分析显示不同专业群体在知识、态度、实践和总 KAP 分数方面存在统计显着差异 (p < 0.05)。此外,效应量分析显示出中等至较大的影响,其中专业类别解释了知识差异的 16%、态度差异的 21%、实践差异的 9% 和总 KAP 分数的差异 24%。结论:研究表明,医护人员在乙型肝炎方面存在 KAP 差距,而辅助医务人员的 KAP 差距更大。这一差距需要通过创建中央数据库、定期提醒 疫苗接种、加强 HICC 以及对医护人员的废物处理指导来填补。

title: Histological differences between patients with porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder and fibrosis regression of chronic hepatitis B: an analysis based on machine learning algorithms
abstract: Abstract Background Porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) alters portal hemodynamics, leading to portal hypertension without obvious fibrosis. Incomplete septal fibrosis (ISF) is recognized as one of the pathological hallmarks of PSVD; however, the differences in ISF between patients with PSVD and those with fibrosis regression remain controversial. This study aimed to analyze the vascular and fibrotic characteristics of liver biopsies between two cohorts using machine learning algorithms. Methods 41 patients with PSVD and 40 with chronic hepatitis B who achieved fibrosis regression after 48 weeks of entecavir treatment were enrolled. The fibrosis stage was assessed using the Ishak system. Images of unstained liver biopsy slides were obtained using second-harmonic generation/two-photon excited fluorescence. Machine learning algorithms were adopted for the analysis: arterial density (AD), portal vein density (PVD), central vein density (CVD), collagen proportionate area (CPA), and different areas of CPA on the portal area, zones 1/2/3, and ISF. analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to analyze the vascular and fibrotic characteristics of liver biopsies between patients with porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) and those with fibrosis regression of chronic hepatitis B using machine learning algorithms. The study enrolled 41 PSVD patients and 40 chronic hepatitis B patients who achieved fibrosis regression after 48 weeks of entecavir treatment. The fibrosis stage was assessed using the Ishak system, and images of unstained liver biopsy slides were obtained using second-harmonic generation/two-photon excited fluorescence. The machine learning algorithms analyzed arterial density, portal vein density, central vein density, collagen proportionate area, and different areas of CPA on the portal area, zones 1/2/3, and ISF. The results indicated that patients with PSVD had significantly higher arterial density compared to those with fibrosis regression. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting distinct vascular and fibrotic patterns in PSVD, which may inform more precise diagnostic approaches. The study's findings may contribute to the development of better diagnostic tools for differentiating PSVD from fibrosis regression in chronic hepatitis B patients. However, the study is limited by its abstract-only nature and potential biases in sample selection, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and outcome reporting.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在使用机器学习算法分析两个 队列研究 之间肝活检的血管和纤维化特征。摘要背景门窦血管疾病(PSVD)改变门静脉血流动力学,导致门静脉高压,但无明显纤维化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 方法 纳入恩替卡韦 治疗 治疗 48 周后纤维化消退的 41 例 PSVD 患者和 40 例 慢性乙型肝炎 患者。使用 Ishak 系统评估纤维化阶段。
elements_zh.methods: 采用机器学习算法进行分析:动脉密度(AD)、门静脉密度(PVD)、中央静脉密度(CVD)、胶原比例面积(CPA)以及门静脉区域、1/2/3区和ISF上CPA的不同区域。使用二次谐波产生/双光子激发荧光获得未染色的肝脏活检载玻片的图像。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果与纤维化消退相反,PSVD 患者的 AD 显着较高(17.98 ± 10.38/mm2 vs 8.59 ± 8.28/mm2,P.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为与纤维化消退相比,强调了 PSVD 中不同的血管和纤维化模式,这可能为更精确的诊断方法提供信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发更精确的诊断工具,以区分 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的 PSVD 和纤维化消退。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其仅抽象的性质和肝活检样本选择中的潜在偏差而受到限制,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。由于缺乏详细的统计分析和结果报告,证据强度中等。

title: Hepatitis B Awareness and Recent Testing Among Women in Nigeria: Analysis of the 2024 Demographic and Health Survey
abstract: Introduction: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is hyperendemic in Nigeria, but national data on HBV awareness and testing among women of reproductive age are lacking. Methods: We analysed data from 38,647 women aged 15–49 years in the 2024 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey. We estimated survey-weighted prevalence of having heard of HBV (awareness), recent (12-month) testing among aware women, and recent testing among all women, and fitted survey-weighted logistic and multinomial regression models. Results: Awareness was 53.3% (95% CI 52.1–54.6). Among aware women, 12.9% (95% CI 12.1–13.7) had been recently tested, equivalent to 6.9% (95% CI 6.4–7.4) of all women. Higher education, greater wealth and health insurance were associated with both outcomes; women in the richest quintile had higher odds of recent testing than those in the poorest (adjusted odds ratio 3.29, 95% CI 2.31–4.68), and the wealth gradient was steeper for testing than for awareness on the relative scale. Recent testing among all women was lowest in the South South (5.0%) and North West (5.4%). The North West reported the highest awareness (66.5%), but almost all interviews there were in Hausa, and this estimate may partly reflect recognition of a translated term rather than of HBV itself. Socioeconomic gradients in both outcomes differed significantly by zone. Conclusions: HBV testing lags far behind awareness and is concentrated among more advantaged women. Zonal awareness estimates, particularly for the North West, should be interpreted with caution. Because the data are cross-sectional and self-reported, these associations are not causal. Approaches that make HBV testing routinely available and affordable, particularly within antenatal care, warrant evaluation.

title: CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis beyond programmed cell death protein 1 in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝细胞癌中 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴超出程序性细胞死亡蛋白 1
source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌在慢性炎症、耐受性肝脏微环境中发生。在这种情况下,T 细胞功能障碍限制了程序性死亡 1 (PD-1) 阻断的功效。Liu 等人发表在《世界胃肠肿瘤学杂志》上的新证据表明,CD161 可能代表耗尽的 CD8+ T 细胞内的另一个抑制轴,该轴未被 PD-1/程序性死亡配体-1 通路完全捕获。在他们的研究中,CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使PD-1+区室在PD-1抑制后收缩,CD161表达仍然持续,这表明CD161介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃。从机制上讲,CD161-凝集素样转录物 1 相互作用的持续参与可能会损害 T 细胞效应器功能,并有助于 HBV 感染肝脏中的适应性免疫抵抗。这些发现强调了 CD161 蛋白质水平评估和 PD-1 平行评估对于准确表征免疫抑制的重要性。关键知识差距包括肿瘤微环境中凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源、持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响,以及临床有意义的进展终点的识别。在这篇社论中,我们将这些发现置于机制和转化背景中,强调了 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴作为 PD-1 阻断之外的免疫抵抗的补充途径的潜在作用。总的来说,当前的证据支持谨慎的、假设驱动的转化策略,以评估精心挑选的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者中 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节。

title: Defining the Structure-Activity Relationships of Thiazolide Antivirals: Balancing Potency, Metabolic Stability, and Aqueous Solubility.
abstract: Recent studies on thiazolide antivirals have identified compounds RM5038 and RM5021 as potent inhibitors of hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and influenza A, although their development has been limited by poor aqueous solubility and rapid metabolic clearance. In this work, a series of novel halogen-substituted and 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolide analogs were synthesized using updated convergent synthetic approaches and flexible protecting group strategies. DMPK evaluation demonstrated that 3-X halogen substitution significantly improved aqueous solubility in parallel to enhancing metabolic stability. Within the chlorothiazolide series, compounds 10gand 10l displayed much improved metabolic stability profiles, excellent aqueous solubility representing a 10-fold improvement over the parent drug, together with low single-digit micromolar antiviral (influenza A) activity and acceptable in vitro safety indices. Evaluation of the 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolides also revealed improved in vitro DMPK profiles while retaining micromolar antiviral potency. SAR analysis indicated that short alkyl sulfone substituents containing two to three carbons are optimal for antiviral activity, while branched alkyl groups may provide additional metabolic advantages. In summary, compounds 10g, 10l, and 15d represent promising early leads for progression to in vivo profiling and additional preclinical evaluation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决开发噻唑化物 抗病毒药物 的挑战,该噻唑化物 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染的 治疗 具有更高的效力、代谢稳定性和水溶性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及新型噻唑烷类似物的合成及其 抗病毒药物 抗 HBV 活性的评估,重点是优化其理化性质。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用更新的聚合合成方法和灵活的保护基策略合成了一系列卤素取代的4'-烷基砜噻唑化物类似物。然后他们评估了药物的 DMPK 特征和 抗病毒药物 的体外效力。
elements_zh.main_results: DMPK评价表明,3-X卤素取代显着提高了水溶性和代谢稳定性。化合物 10g 和 10l 表现出大大改善的代谢稳定性、优异的水溶性(比母体药物提高 10 倍)以及针对甲型流感病毒的低个位数微摩尔 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,特定的结构修饰可以增强噻唑烷类化合物的理化性质,而不影响其 抗病毒药物 效力,为 HBV 药物设计提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发更有效的抗 HBV 的 抗病毒药物 药物奠定了基础,可能改善 治疗 的选择并减少当前噻唑类药物的局限性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外评估,证据仅基于摘要数据,可能无法完全反映体内疗效或安全性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

abstract_zh: 最近对噻唑化物 抗病毒药物 的研究已确定化合物 RM5038 和 RM5021 是 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和甲型流感病毒的有效抑制剂,尽管它们的开发受到水溶性差和快速代谢清除的限制。在这项工作中,使用更新的聚合合成方法和灵活的保护基策略合成了一系列新型卤素取代和4'-烷基砜噻唑化物类似物。DMPK 评估表明,3-X 卤素取代显着提高了水溶性,同时增强了代谢稳定性。在氯噻唑系列中,化合物 10g 和 10l 显示出大大改善的代谢稳定性、优异的水溶性(比母体药物提高了 10 倍)、低个位数微摩尔 抗病毒药物(甲型流感)活性和可接受的体外安全指数。对 4'-烷基砜噻唑烷的评估还揭示了体外 DMPK 特性的改善,同时保留了微摩尔 抗病毒药物 效力。SAR 分析表明,含有 2 至 3 个碳的短烷基砜取代基对于 抗病毒药物 活性是最佳的,而支链烷基可能提供额外的代谢优势。总之,化合物 10g、10l 和 15d 代表了进行体内分析和其他临床前评估的有希望的早期先导化合物。

title: Engineered Exosomes Delivering FOSB siRNA Alleviate Podocyte Injury in Hepatitis B Virus-Associated Nephritis
abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus-associated glomerulonephritis (HBV-GN) is the common extrahepatic manifestation of HBV infection and a major secondary glomerular disease in China. Upregulated FOSB mediates podocyte injury induced by HBx, whereas silencing FOSB can reverse this pathological change. Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (BMSC-Exos) exhibit excellent biocompatibility, while their clinical application is limited by short circulating half-life and insufficient drug loading capacity. Herein, we constructed Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified BMSC-Exos encapsulated with FOSB siRNA and investigated its therapeutic potential against HBx-mediated podocyte damage. Transcriptomic analysis of renal samples from HBV-GN patients and healthy volunteers screened FOSB as a key pathogenic gene. We established an in vitro HBx-overexpressing podocyte model and an in vivo HBx transgenic mouse model. Engineered exosomes were prepared via covalent coupling of Cyclo(RGDfC) and siRNA loading, followed by comprehensive characterization. Our data verified that HBx induced FOSB overexpression. Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified engineered exosomes can be internalized by podocytes. Relative to unmodified exosomes, these constructs significantly downregulated FOSB, alleviated podocyte apoptosis and inflammatory response, and ameliorated renal lesions and dysfunction in transgenic mice. Collectively, Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified FOSB siRNA-loaded BMSC-Exos hinder HBV-GN progression through inhibiting FOSB-dependent podocyte injury, which represents a prospective therapeutic strategy for HBV-GN.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒相关性肾小球肾炎(HBV-GN)是HBV感染的重要肝外表现,也是我国主要的继发性肾小球疾病。该研究旨在通过针对 FOSB 介导的足细胞损伤来探索 HBV-GN 的新治疗策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及体外 HBx 过表达足细胞模型和体内 HBx 转基因小鼠模型。对 HBV-GN 患者和健康志愿者肾脏样本的转录组分析确定 FOSB 是关键致病基因。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 Cyclo(RGDfC) 和 siRNA 负载的共价偶联制备工程外泌体,然后进行综合表征。在体外和体内模型中研究了这些外泌体的治疗潜力。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的数据证实 HBx 诱导 FOSB 过度表达。Cyclo(RGDfC)修饰的工程外泌体被足细胞内化,并显着下调 FOSB,减轻足细胞凋亡和炎症反应,并改善转基因小鼠的肾脏病变和功能障碍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,传递 FOSB siRNA 的工程外泌体可以有效抑制 FOSB 依赖性足细胞损伤,为 HBV-GN 提供一种有前景的治疗策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为 HBV-GN 的 治疗 提供了一种潜在的新方法,可以为该疾病的未来研究和治疗开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 骨髓间充质干细胞来源的外泌体由于其循环半衰期短和载药能力不足,在临床应用中受到限制。然而,该研究的结果得到了体外和体内模型的支持,为工程外泌体的治疗潜力提供了一定的信心。

title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨华支睾吸虫合并感染是否会在肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者中诱导 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。背景强调,已知中华支原体合并感染会加速乙型肝炎患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在流行地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究纳入了 117 名参与者,分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、中华支原体单一感染参与者(n = 29)、HBV 单一感染参与者(n = 28)和混合感染参与者(n = 30)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。
elements_zh.main_results: HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,共同感染组的炎症细胞因子:白细胞介素-6 (IL-6) 和肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNF-α) 水平较高,同时干扰素-γ (IFN-γ) 水平明显较低。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,中华线虫合并感染与通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高而产生的免疫抑制有关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。这一发现强调了共感染可能调节 HBV 患者 免疫应答 的新机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了其建立因果关系的能力。证据基于相关性和中介分析,可能无法完全捕捉感染与 免疫应答 之间复杂的相互作用。信心是中等的。

Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.
abstract_zh: 背景已知华支睾吸虫(C. sinensis)合并感染会加速乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在两种感染流行的地区。代谢重编程已成为免疫抑制的关键驱动因素。这些代谢变化通常是由骨髓源性抑制细胞(MDSC)精心策划的,这些细胞在慢性感染期间会扩张以促进免疫耐受。中华丝虫合并感染会重新编程代谢以有利于 MDSC 相关的抑制,而这一过程与正常肝酶水平的关系仍不清楚。目的 探讨中华支原体合并感染是否会诱导肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者发生 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。方法 在这项横断面研究中,总共招募了 117 名参与者,并分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、单一感染中华支原体的参与者(n = 29)、单一感染 HBV 的参与者(n = 28)和混合感染的参与者(n = 30)。使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。进行 Spearman 相关性和中介分析来探讨炎症、代谢和免疫之间的关系。结果 HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,与HBV单一感染组相比,合并感染组的炎症细胞因子白细胞介素6(IL-6)和肿瘤坏死因子-α(TNF-α)水平较高,同时干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)水平明显较低。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。在代谢方面,共同感染组的鸟氨酸与精氨酸的比率显着较高。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。中华线虫合并感染通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高与免疫抑制相关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨华支睾吸虫合并感染是否会在肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者中诱导 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。背景强调,已知中华支原体合并感染会加速乙型肝炎患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在流行地区。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了其建立因果关系的能力。证据基于相关性和中介分析,可能无法完全捕捉感染与 免疫应答 之间复杂的相互作用。信心是中等的。

title: Residual Hepatitis B Burden Despite Declining Rates Across 21 Middle East and North Africa Countries, 1990–2023: Age Patterns and a Case Study of Oman
abstract: Across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), the age-standardized rates (ASRs) of hepatitis B virus (HBV) burden may be declining while the absolute burden rises among middle-aged and older adults. In this study, we aimed to characterize changes in rates, counts, and age distribution across 21 MENA countries, with Oman as a case study.

title: Interferon therapy reduces incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with high risk of hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: BACKGROUND The proportion of patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is as high as 85.69% among HCC patients in China. Current anti-HBV drugs include nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) and interferon (IFN). AIM To compare the impact of NAs and IFN therapy on the occurrence of HCC in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC. METHODS We enrolled 368 patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC, and 120 received subcutaneous injections of IFN, with or without NAs, constituting the IFN group. The remaining 248 patients were assigned to the NAs group, and received treatment with NAs alone. RESULTS For patients with a high risk of HBV-related HCC, after a 5-year treatment period, HCC incidence in the IFN group was 2.54%, while the NAs group showed a significantly higher incidence of 25.74% (P CONCLUSION IFN-based therapy, compared with NAs, significantly reduced the risk of HCC in patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC.
